items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: I knew his son. He had a band I played against him at the Santa Santa Club.

ctx.x: Ah. What's this Clarence Williams, you remember Clarence Williams? Yeah, I remember you talking about. I knew his son.

He had a band I played against him at the Santa Santa Club. You see they all wanted to play with me down there because whenever I played the Santa Santa Santa Club we turned them away. Now let's don't confuse this.
